title: 13-Week Cash Flow Forecasting and Working Capital Planning
summary: A 13-week cash forecast, rolling with scenarios on the CFO tier, to plan working capital and avoid cash surprises.
metaTitle: 13-Week Cash Flow Forecast and Working Capital Planning
metaDescription: A rolling 13-week cash flow forecast with scenarios to plan working capital, collections and payables. Included in Growth and CFO plans for India and the GCC.
heroIntro: Know where cash will be in 13 weeks, and what to do about it today.
overview: Profitable businesses still run out of cash. A 13-week forecast links receivables, payables, payroll, tax payments and loan repayments to a weekly cash position, so you can see pinch points early and decide what to do.
whatWeDo: Forecast cash over 13 weeks and plan working capital.
Link receivables, payables, payroll, tax and loan payments to a weekly cash view.
Update the forecast against actuals each cycle.
Model scenarios such as slower collections or a large purchase (CFO tier).
Include the cash view in your MIS and review call.

faqs.a: A weekly projection of cash in and out for the next 13 weeks (one quarter), updated regularly against actuals.
